data.title: Crypto Fraud-Terrorism/Narco Financing Nexus — Sanctions-Exposed Wallets and Peel Chain Patterns Through Mixing Services
data.description: Detects the crypto-terror/narco financing nexus pattern where transactions flow to wallets with known OFAC/sanctions exposure, or exhibit peel chain patterns through cryptocurrency mixing services followed by consolidation to designated entity-linked addresses. INTERPOL's 2026 Global Financial Fraud Threat Assessment documents two confirmed manifestations: (1) a USD 150 million cryptocurrency fraud scheme linked to Tren de Aragua laundering drug trafficking and extortion proceeds across Chile, Colombia, Venezuela, and the Iberian Peninsula; and (2) Operation Catalyst, which uncovered a USD 562 million crypto Ponzi scheme affecting 100,000+ victims across 17 countries with wallet-level links to terrorism financing in Central Africa. The detection logic targets three signatures: direct transactions to OFAC SDN-listed wallet addresses within 2 hops, peel chain patterns where funds are split into decreasingly small amounts through mixing services before reconsolidation, and co-mingling indicators where platform wallets receive both retail investor deposits and large round-number inflows from high-risk wallet clusters. This rule operates at critical severity given the terrorism and narcotics financing implications and associated OFAC blocking obligations.

enrichment_required.source: OFAC SDN wallet cluster database — minimum hop count from counterparty wallet to nearest SDN-listed address
OFAC SDN entity name associated with nearest SDN-listed wallet
Blockchain analytics — true if transaction chain passes through known mixing/tumbling service within specified timeframe
Hours between initial transaction and first mixing service interaction in the chain
Blockchain analytics — true if transaction exhibits peel chain splitting pattern (decreasing amounts to sequential wallets)
Risk score (0-100) of the wallet where peel chain funds reconsolidate, based on known entity associations
Blockchain analytics wallet clustering — categorization of counterparty wallet cluster (sanctions, terror-financing, narco, high-risk-exchange, unknown)

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Crypto-Terror/Narco Nexus Detection")`
`comment("Detects transactions to OFAC-exposed wallets and peel chain patterns through mixers")`
index=flame_blockchain sourcetype=flame:chain_monitoring
  (transaction_type="crypto_transfer" OR transaction_type="crypto_deposit" OR transaction_type="crypto_withdrawal")
  amount_usd>=1000
  (sdn_hop_distance<=2 OR (mixing_service_interaction="true" AND peel_chain_detected="true"))
| eval chain_classification = case(
    sdn_hop_distance<=1, "direct_sdn_exposure",
    sdn_hop_distance==2, "indirect_sdn_exposure",
    mixing_service_interaction=="true" AND peel_chain_detected=="true", "peel_chain_mixing",
    1=1, "unknown")
| eval severity = case(
    sdn_hop_distance<=1 AND amount_usd >= 50000, "critical",
    sdn_hop_distance<=1, "critical",
    sdn_hop_distance==2 AND amount_usd >= 100000, "critical",
    peel_chain_detected=="true" AND consolidation_wallet_risk_score >= 90, "critical",
    1=1, "high")
| stats sum(amount_usd) AS total_volume,
        count AS transaction_count,
        dc(counterparty_wallet) AS unique_counterparties,
        values(chain_classification) AS classifications,
        values(sdn_entity_name) AS sdn_entities,
        max(severity) AS max_severity
  BY wallet_address
| table wallet_address, total_volume, transaction_count, unique_counterparties,
        classifications, sdn_entities, max_severity
| sort - total_volume
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Crypto-Terror/Narco Nexus Detection
-- Detects sanctions-exposed wallet transactions and peel chain laundering patterns
SELECT
  t.transaction_id,
  t.transaction_hash,
  t.wallet_address,
  t.counterparty_wallet,
  t.amount_usd,
  t.crypto_currency,
  t.transaction_date,
  s.sdn_entity_name,
  s.sdn_hop_distance,
  s.wallet_cluster_risk_category,
  m.mixing_service_name,
  m.hours_to_mix,
  p.peel_chain_depth,
  p.consolidation_wallet,
  p.consolidation_wallet_risk_score,
  CASE
    WHEN s.sdn_hop_distance <= 1 THEN 'direct_sdn_exposure'
    WHEN s.sdn_hop_distance = 2 THEN 'indirect_sdn_exposure'
    WHEN m.mixing_service_interaction = TRUE AND p.peel_chain_detected = TRUE THEN 'peel_chain_mixing'
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS chain_classification
FROM crypto_transactions t
LEFT JOIN sdn_wallet_proximity s
  ON t.counterparty_wallet = s.wallet_address
LEFT JOIN mixing_service_interactions m
  ON t.transaction_hash = m.source_transaction_hash
LEFT JOIN peel_chain_analysis p
  ON t.transaction_hash = p.origin_transaction_hash
WHERE t.amount_usd >= 1000
  AND t.transaction_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND (
    s.sdn_hop_distance <= 2
    OR (m.mixing_service_interaction = TRUE
        AND m.hours_to_mix <= 24
        AND p.peel_chain_detected = TRUE
        AND p.consolidation_wallet_risk_score >= 80)
  )
ORDER BY t.amount_usd DESC

OFAC, Sanctions Compliance Guidance for the Virtual Currency Industry, October 2021
FinCEN, Advisory on Illicit Activity Involving Convertible Virtual Currency, May 2019
Arkham Intelligence illicit wallet tag database (intel.arkm.com/tags/suspicious) — open-source wallet attribution starting point for sanctions-exposed and illicit wallet identification
Florida FOIA records — unredacted cryptocurrency wallet addresses in police reports and AG consumer complaints provide victim-linked address ground truth
Exchange Proof-of-Reserves CSVs (Binance, OKX, Bybit) — publicly available exchange address attribution resource for confirming exchange relationships
ICIJ/OpenCorporates, The Modern Money Trail Crypto & Cash webinar (2026) — OSINT methodology for wallet attribution without proprietary analytics access
falsepositives: Legitimate crypto transactions to wallets that share cluster membership with SDN-listed addresses due to prior commingling on large exchanges
Privacy-conscious users routing transactions through mixing services for personal privacy without illicit intent
False positive wallet clustering where blockchain analytics incorrectly associates unrelated wallets
